title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_description:
Can you guess which egg has the dragon hiding inside? 🐉🥚 Watch to find out! Like and subscribe for a new guessing game every day!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Eggs #Kidify #FunForKids #PuzzleForKids

scenes.narration: One of these eggs hides a dragon — but which one?
We've got the red egg, the blue egg, and the golden egg. Pick your favorite!
The dragon is hiding... three... two... one!
The red egg? Nope! Just a rubber duck in there. Quack!
The blue egg? No way! It's a tiny little snail. So slow!
That means it's the golden egg! A real dragon was hiding in there the whole time!
Did you get it right? Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
